
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(xts)
library(zoo)
library(readr)
library(purrr)

ddir <- file.path(getwd(), "data")
wdir <- getwd()
dir.create("output/uk", showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- 1. Pull all series from FRED ----
fred_series <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,            ~fred_id,
  "Unemployment",   "LRHUTTTTGBQ156S",
  "CPI",            "GBRCPIALLQINMEI",
  "GDP",            "CLVMNACSCAB1GQUK",
  "Policy_Rate",    "IRSTCI01GBQ156N",
  "Long_Rate",      "IRLTLT01GBQ156N",
  "Short_Rate",     "IR3TIB01GBQ156N",
  "Claimant_Count", "LMUNRRTTGBQ156S"
)

pull_fred <- function(name, fred_id) {
  url <- sprintf("https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=%s", fred_id)
  df  <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
  names(df) <- c("date", name)
  df |>
    mutate(date = as.Date(date),
           !!name := as.numeric(.data[[name]]))
}

fred_list <- map2(fred_series$name, fred_series$fred_id, pull_fred)
names(fred_list) <- fred_series$name

# Cache locally so you don't re-pull every render
walk2(fred_list, fred_series$name,
      ~ write_csv(.x, sprintf("data/uk/%s.csv", .y)))

# ---- 2. Build aligned quarterly panel ----
uk_panel <- reduce(fred_list, full_join, by = "date") |>
  arrange(date) |>
  rename(time = date) |>
  filter(time >= as.Date("1983-01-01"))

cat("UK panel: ", nrow(uk_panel), " quarters, ",
    format(min(uk_panel$time)), " to ", format(max(uk_panel$time)), "\n", sep = "")
cat("NA counts per column:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(uk_panel)))

# ---- 3. Build cross-year lags and differenced target ----
uk_model_df <- uk_panel |>
  rename(unemployment = Unemployment) |>
  arrange(time) |>
  mutate(
    y_lag4         = lag(unemployment, 4),
    y_lag8         = lag(unemployment, 8),
    y_yoy          = y_lag4 - lag(unemployment, 8),
    d_unemployment = unemployment - y_lag4
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(y_lag8), !is.na(d_unemployment),
         !is.na(CPI), !is.na(GDP),
         !is.na(Policy_Rate), !is.na(Long_Rate)) |>
  select(-unemployment, -Claimant_Count)  # drop level + the alt target

# Leak guard
stopifnot(!"unemployment" %in% colnames(uk_model_df))

saveRDS(uk_model_df, "output/uk/uk_model_df_diff.rds")
cat("\nUK modelling sample: ", nrow(uk_model_df), " quarters, ",
    format(min(uk_model_df$time)), " to ", format(max(uk_model_df$time)), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Features: ", paste(setdiff(colnames(uk_model_df),
                                 c("time", "d_unemployment")), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ---- 2. Build aligned quarterly panel ----
uk_panel <- reduce(fred_list, full_join, by = "date") |>
  arrange(date) |>
  rename(time = date) |>
  filter(time >= as.Date("1983-01-01"))

# SAVE THE FULL PANEL — this is the file run_uk_pipeline expects to read
saveRDS(uk_panel, "output/uk/uk_panel.rds")

cat("UK panel: ", nrow(uk_panel), " quarters, ",
    format(min(uk_panel$time)), " to ", format(max(uk_panel$time)), "\n", sep = "")
cat("NA counts per column:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(uk_panel)))
```
